signalAmbiguityReview.basis: Manual review of decoded source frames, independent of detector output. The renderer uses inclusive transition endpoints with red, then amber, then green overlay priority, so frames 60, 90, and 210 show green, amber, and green respectively. No signal-state intervals were ambiguous; the red-crossing boundary judgement is documented with its event annotation.

events.notes: At decoded frame 33 (1.100 s) the gold car nose remains before the stop line; by decoded frame 36 (1.200 s) it has crossed. Both boundary frames show green.

Use the leading front-bumper/headlight tip as the nose reference against the diagonal stop-stripe centerline. At decoded frame 178 (5.933 s) the tip reaches the stripe; by frame 179 (5.967 s) it is approximately 2 px beyond it. Both boundary frames show red. Earlier proposed brackets 167/168 and 174/175 were before the crossing and are invalid.

The blue car is stationary and visibly behind the stop line during [3, 7) s. This window includes amber at frame 90 and red frames 91–209; green returns at frame 210 (7 s), immediately after the stop interval ends.
